# Stellar TimeLock Vault

> Non-custodial time-lock vault wallet for Android, built on Stellar/Soroban.

Stellar TimeLock Vault lets users lock XLM and other Stellar assets in Soroban smart contracts until a chosen unlock time. Features include standard time-locks, cooling-off periods, vesting schedules, dead man's switch vaults, and multi-asset support.

This GitHub repository is an open-source **security and legal reference**. It does not contain the full Android app source. It documents contract addresses, network endpoints, privacy/terms/disclosures, and how to verify the app's non-custodial design.
